name: Charming Blood
source:
Night is the time of vampires. A time of secrets, danger and death... And also a time of freedom, passion, true friendship and love.
___
Vampires have lived in the neighborhood for many centuries, and people don't even suspect it.
But sooner or later, the secret becomes obvious...
Feel yourself in the role of a young guy who, against his will, becomes a vampire.
It is not easy to adapt to a new life, especially when night dwellers are looking for ancient forces and preparing for a new war, but you are not a simple guy anymore!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055060/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
夜晚是吸血鬼的时间。这是一个充满秘密、危险和死亡的时代……也是一个充满自由、激情、真正的友谊和爱的时代。
___
吸血鬼在这附近生活了很多个世纪，人们甚至没有怀疑过。
但迟早，这个秘密会变得显而易见……
感觉自己扮演一个年轻人的角色，他违背自己的意愿变成了吸血鬼。
适应新的生活并不容易，尤其是当夜行者正在寻找古老的力量并准备新的战争时，但你不再是一个简单的家伙了！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055060/]Steam[/url]]
